svg.title: MWFL native Windows application showcase
svg.desc: Markdown editing, Explorer-style navigation, and an IDE docking workspace composed from real HWND controls.

g.text: Native Windows UI, composed in modern C++20.
Real HWNDs · typed events · responsive DIPs · direct Win32 interop
Markdown Editor · Scintilla + offline WebView2 preview
Explorer · tree, virtual list, tabs, splitter
Docking IDE · dock, float, auto-hide, persist
